verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships configurable automation surfaces, such as voice agents and CLI-scripted workflows, so asking about versioning them is a fair question for this kind of platform. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations or agent configurations. Selecting a model version (diarize_model) and CI-friendly CLI exit codes are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
